name: Trophimus
bio: Trophimus, from Asia, was among those who accompanied Paul from Greece into Asia on his journey back toward Jerusalem (Acts 20:4). His later presence with Paul in Jerusalem, which sparked a riot, is told in the chapters ahead. Jews from Asia later saw Trophimus, a Gentile, with Paul in Jerusalem and falsely assumed Paul had brought him into the temple, sparking the riot that led to Paul's arrest (Acts 21:29).
